subject: Biology SL
title: Biology SL Paper 2 Section A Mock v2

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Answer all parts about gene expression and translation.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: State the molecule that carries the coded information from a transcribed gene to a ribosome.
markscheme: mRNA / messenger RNA.
markschemeJa: mRNA／メッセンジャーRNA。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain the role of tRNA during translation.
markscheme: Each tRNA carries a specific amino acid to the ribosome.
The tRNA anticodon pairs with a complementary mRNA codon so the correct amino acid is added to the growing polypeptide.
markschemeJa: 各tRNAは特定のアミノ酸をリボソームへ運ぶ。
tRNAのアンチコドンが相補的なmRNAコドンと対合し、正しいアミノ酸がポリペプチドへ加えられる。
parts.modelAnswer: tRNA carries a specific amino acid and uses its anticodon to pair with the matching mRNA codon, ensuring the amino acid is added in the correct order.
parts.modelAnswerJa: tRNAは特定のアミノ酸を運び、アンチコドンで対応するmRNAコドンと対合して、正しい順序でアミノ酸を加えます。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: A base substitution changes one codon but does not change the amino acid encoded. Explain how this can occur and why the protein sequence remains unchanged.
markscheme: The genetic code is degenerate, so more than one codon can specify the same amino acid.
The changed codon can therefore still recruit a tRNA carrying the same amino acid.
Because the amino-acid sequence is unchanged, the primary structure of the polypeptide remains unchanged at that position.
markschemeJa: 遺伝暗号には縮重があり、複数のコドンが同じアミノ酸を指定できる。
そのため変化後のコドンでも同じアミノ酸を運ぶtRNAが対応しうる。
アミノ酸配列が変わらないため、その位置でポリペプチドの一次構造は変化しない。
parts.modelAnswer: The genetic code is degenerate, so a different codon can still specify the same amino acid. The same amino acid is inserted, leaving the polypeptide sequence unchanged at that position.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 遺伝暗号には縮重があるため、別のコドンでも同じアミノ酸を指定できます。同じアミノ酸が入るので、その位置のポリペプチド配列は変わりません。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Researchers measured glucose uptake by intestinal epithelial cells.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate the percentage reduction in glucose uptake caused by the ATP-production inhibitor at an external glucose concentration of 8 mmol dm⁻³.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why the inhibitor reduces glucose uptake and why uptake is not reduced to zero.
markscheme: ATP is required directly or indirectly for active transport mechanisms that maintain ion gradients used for glucose uptake.
Inhibiting ATP production weakens these gradients / active transport and reduces the rate of glucose uptake.
Some glucose can still enter by passive or facilitated diffusion, so uptake does not fall to zero.
markschemeJa: ATPは、グルコース取り込みに利用されるイオン勾配を維持する能動輸送に直接または間接に必要である。
ATP産生を阻害すると勾配や能動輸送が弱まり、グルコース取り込み速度が低下する。
一部のグルコースは受動輸送や促進拡散でも入れるため、取り込みは0にはならない。
parts.modelAnswer: ATP supports active transport and the ion gradients that drive glucose uptake. Blocking ATP production reduces this transport, but passive or facilitated diffusion can still occur.
parts.modelAnswerJa: ATPは能動輸送とグルコース取り込みに使うイオン勾配を支えます。ATP産生を止めると取り込みは低下しますが、促進拡散などは残るため0にはなりません。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how microvilli make intestinal epithelial cells better adapted for nutrient absorption.
markscheme: Microvilli increase the plasma-membrane surface area available for absorption.
The larger surface can contain more transport proteins, increasing the capacity or rate of nutrient uptake.
markschemeJa: 微絨毛は吸収に利用できる細胞膜表面積を増やす。
広い表面により多くの輸送タンパク質を配置でき、栄養吸収能力・速度が高まる。
parts.modelAnswer: Microvilli increase membrane surface area and allow more transport proteins, increasing nutrient absorption capacity.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 微絨毛は膜表面積を増やし、より多くの輸送タンパク質を配置できるため、栄養吸収能力が高まります。

stimulus.title: Glucose uptake by intestinal epithelial cells
stimulus.description: Uptake was measured with normal ATP production and after adding an inhibitor of ATP production.

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: A student measured carbon dioxide production by yeast supplied with different sugars.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Identify the sugar that produced the greatest carbon dioxide volume after 12 minutes.
markscheme: Glucose.
markschemeJa: グルコース。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Calculate the mean rate of carbon dioxide production for glucose over the 12-minute period.
markscheme: Glucose produced 18.0 cm³ of carbon dioxide in 12 min.
Mean rate = 18.0 ÷ 12 = 1.5 cm³ min⁻¹.
markschemeJa: グルコースでは12分で18.0 cm³の二酸化炭素が生じた。
平均速度＝18.0÷12＝1.5 cm³ min⁻¹。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain why carbon dioxide production can be used as an indicator of the rate of energy-releasing metabolism in yeast under these conditions.
markscheme: Yeast can metabolize sugars through pathways that release energy and produce carbon dioxide as a product.
A greater amount of carbon dioxide produced per unit time therefore indicates a higher rate of the carbon-dioxide-producing metabolic pathway, assuming other conditions are controlled.
markschemeJa: 酵母は糖を代謝してエネルギーを得る過程で二酸化炭素を生成できる。
他条件が一定なら、単位時間あたりの二酸化炭素生成量が多いほど、その二酸化炭素を生じる代謝経路の速度が高いと考えられる。
parts.modelAnswer: Yeast sugar metabolism can release carbon dioxide, so more carbon dioxide per unit time indicates a faster rate of that metabolic pathway when other variables are controlled.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 酵母の糖代謝では二酸化炭素が生じるため、他条件が一定なら単位時間あたりの二酸化炭素量が多いほど代謝速度が高いと考えられます。

parts.label: (d)
parts.question: Suggest one variable that should be controlled when comparing the sugars.
markscheme: A relevant variable such as temperature, pH, yeast concentration, sugar concentration or experiment duration is controlled.
markschemeJa: 温度、pH、酵母濃度、糖濃度、実験時間など適切な変数を一定にする。
parts.modelAnswer: For example, temperature and yeast concentration should be kept constant.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 例えば温度と酵母濃度を一定にします。

stimulus.title: Carbon dioxide produced by yeast
stimulus.description: Equal yeast suspensions received equal molar concentrations of different sugars.

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: The table summarizes the response to two exposures to the same antigen.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Compare the primary and secondary responses.
markscheme: The secondary response reaches a much higher peak antibody concentration than the primary response.
The secondary response reaches its peak sooner / has a shorter delay than the primary response.
markschemeJa: 二次応答は一次応答よりはるかに高い抗体濃度ピークに達する。
二次応答は一次応答より早くピークに達し、遅延が短い。
parts.modelAnswer: The secondary response is faster and reaches a much higher antibody concentration.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 二次応答はより速く、より高い抗体濃度に達します。

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Calculate how many days earlier the peak occurs in the secondary response.
markscheme: 18 − 7 = 11 days earlier.

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain the biological basis for the faster and larger secondary response.
markscheme: The first exposure activates antigen-specific lymphocytes and generates memory cells.
Memory cells persist after the primary response has declined.
On second exposure, memory cells rapidly undergo clonal expansion and differentiate into effector cells, producing a larger response such as rapid antibody secretion.
markschemeJa: 初回曝露で抗原特異的リンパ球が活性化され、記憶細胞が形成される。
記憶細胞は一次応答が低下した後も残る。
再曝露時に記憶細胞が速やかにクローン増殖・エフェクター細胞へ分化し、迅速な抗体分泌など大きな応答を生じる。
parts.modelAnswer: The primary exposure creates persistent memory cells. On re-exposure they expand and differentiate rapidly, producing a faster and larger specific immune response.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 一次曝露で記憶細胞が残り、再曝露時に速やかに増殖・分化するため、より速く大きな特異的免疫応答が生じます。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: Plant cells were placed in solutions with different water potentials.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Identify the solution in which the mean cell length changed least from the initial length.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Explain why cells increase in length in the −0.2 MPa solution.
markscheme: The external solution has a higher (less negative) water potential than the cell contents.
Water enters the cells by osmosis, increasing cell volume/turgor and therefore mean cell length.
markschemeJa: 外液は細胞内より高い（負の程度が小さい）水ポテンシャルをもつ。
水が浸透によって細胞内へ入り、細胞体積・膨圧が増して平均細胞長が増える。
parts.modelAnswer: The −0.2 MPa solution has higher water potential, so water enters by osmosis and the cells become more turgid and longer.
parts.modelAnswerJa: −0.2 MPa溶液の方が水ポテンシャルが高いため、水が浸透して細胞内へ入り、膨圧が増して長くなります。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Predict the effect on a plant cell placed in a solution with a water potential much lower than −1.0 MPa.
markscheme: More water would leave the cell by osmosis, reducing cell volume and turgor.
The plasma membrane could pull away from the cell wall as the cell becomes plasmolysed.
markschemeJa: さらに多くの水が浸透によって細胞外へ出て、細胞体積と膨圧が低下する。
細胞が原形質分離し、細胞膜が細胞壁から離れる可能性がある。
parts.modelAnswer: More water would leave the cell, reducing turgor; a sufficiently strong water loss could cause plasmolysis.
parts.modelAnswerJa: さらに水が細胞外へ出て膨圧が低下し、十分に強い脱水では原形質分離が起こりえます。

questions.subject: Biology SL
questions.question: A single-gene trait has two alleles, R and r. R is dominant.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question: Calculate the observed recessive phenotype percentage.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question: Compare the observed recessive count with the count expected from a 3:1 phenotype ratio.
markscheme: A 3:1 ratio predicts 196 ÷ 4 = 49 recessive individuals; the observed value of 48 is very close.
markschemeJa: 3:1なら劣性は196÷4＝49個体と予想され、観察値48は非常に近い。
parts.modelAnswer: 49 would be expected; 48 were observed, so the values are very close.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 49個体が期待され、48個体が観察されたので非常に近いです。

parts.label: (c)
parts.question: Explain how meiosis and fertilization can generate an approximately 3:1 phenotype ratio from two heterozygous parents.
markscheme: In each heterozygous parent, the R and r alleles segregate during meiosis so gametes carry one allele each.
Random fertilization gives genotype probabilities of approximately 1 RR : 2 Rr : 1 rr.
Because R is dominant, RR and Rr have the dominant phenotype, producing about 3 dominant : 1 recessive.
markschemeJa: 各ヘテロ接合親では減数分裂でRとrが分離し、各配偶子は一方の対立遺伝子をもつ。
ランダムな受精により遺伝子型は約1 RR : 2 Rr : 1 rrとなる。
Rが優性なのでRRとRrが優性表現型となり、約3優性:1劣性となる。
parts.modelAnswer: Alleles segregate so each parent forms R and r gametes. Random fertilization gives about 1 RR:2 Rr:1 rr, which becomes a 3:1 phenotype ratio because R is dominant.
parts.modelAnswerJa: 対立遺伝子が分離して各親がRとrの配偶子をつくり、ランダム受精で1:2:1の遺伝子型比となり、Rが優性なので表現型は約3:1になります。
